# Source-checked allocation fixtures

These selected recorded-rule payloads were staged from the following ANU pages on 6 October 2026. They preserve complex clauses rather than treating planner test success as complete publication verification.

- https://programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/2025/program/BCOMP
- https://programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/2025/program/BECON
- https://programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/2027/program/BCOMM
- https://programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/2027/major/PSTO-MAJ

BCOMP uses the source-correct restricted union. PSTO uses the three independently verified six-unit analysis courses. Selected-major structure_set remains deliberately unmeasured. Course fixtures are allocation probes, not prerequisite/offerings verification.
